name: pibrain
description: Personal knowledge base: search, read and record facts about the home network, Cloudflare, Postgres, Proxmox, Tailscale, pi and individual projects.
long_description: The Claude counterpart of the PiBrain pi extension. Exposes the same seven memory_* tools over the same self-hosted PostgREST API. The API key is read from BRAIN_API_KEY or ~/.zshenv; it is not stored in the extension.

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: Search the knowledge base; returns previews with ids.

tools.name: memory_correct
tools.description: Replace a stale row or remove one that was never true.

prompts.name: sweep
prompts.description: Sweep this session for rows worth recording.
prompts.text: Review this session and record PiBrain rows for anything worth keeping, then call memory_session_end.
